# `blocking-in-sequential`: Blocking assignment appears in sequential logic / 时序逻辑中使用了阻塞赋值

**Severity / 严重程度:** `warning`

## English

### Cause

A clocked process updates state with a blocking assignment, so later statements can observe the new value during the same simulation event.

### Risk

Statement ordering can introduce simulator races and make the modeled register behavior differ from the intended synchronous hardware.

### Fix

Use nonblocking assignments for registered state and calculate combinational next-state values separately when intermediate results are needed.

## 简体中文

### 原因

时钟触发过程使用阻塞赋值更新状态，导致后续语句可能在同一仿真事件中立即看到新值。

### 风险

语句顺序可能引入仿真竞争，使寄存器模型与预期同步硬件行为不一致。

### 修复

对寄存状态使用非阻塞赋值；需要中间计算时，将组合的下一状态逻辑单独写出。

## Failing example / 问题示例

```systemverilog
module blocking_in_sequential(input logic clk, input logic data_i, output logic data_o);
  always_ff @(posedge clk) data_o = data_i;
endmodule
```

## Fixed example / 修复示例

```systemverilog
module blocking_in_sequential(input logic clk, input logic data_i, output logic data_o);
  always_ff @(posedge clk) data_o <= data_i;
endmodule
```
